findings.title: Incorrect hunk counts make the patch unapplyable
findings.message: The embedded patch is malformed: this hunk contains 13 old lines and 14 new lines, but declares 14 and 15. The native-composition hunk likewise declares 16/24 while containing 15/23. Patch tools will reject the patch, preventing the changes from being installed.
findings.suggestion: Regenerate the patch from the source changes and validate it with git apply --check. Correct this header to @@ -1791,13 +1667,14 @@ and the native-composition header to @@ -130,15 +132,23 @@, and audit the remaining hunk counts.

findings.title: Vertical navigation ignores unsupported-line flags
findings.message: Vertical navigation accepts carets on lines marked Unsupported. A mixed horizontal/vertical or math line can still contain carets for its supported runs, so moving into that line selects only those runs instead of using the legacy navigation fallback. Moving from a mixed unsupported line has the same problem. This makes some content unreachable or places the cursor incorrectly.
findings.suggestion: Before using caret-based vertical navigation, check the Unsupported flag for both the current and target lines. If either is unsupported, use RuneAtLineDelta and the existing grapheme-clamping fallback. Add a test with a target line containing both supported and unsupported runs.
